cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5.0)
project(core_napi)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)

# Generated by package_har.sh (CORE_A_PATH / CORE_INCLUDE / optional GL).
if(EXISTS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/core_paths.cmake")
  include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/core_paths.cmake")
endif()

if(NOT DEFINED CORE_A_PATH OR NOT EXISTS "${CORE_A_PATH}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "CORE_A_PATH missing. Run package_har.sh / build_ohos.sh first.")
endif()
if(NOT DEFINED CORE_INCLUDE OR NOT IS_DIRECTORY "${CORE_INCLUDE}")
  message(FATAL_ERROR "CORE_INCLUDE missing.")
endif()

option(CORE_ENABLE_GL "Link Assimp + GLES + XComponent GL surface" ON)

set(CORE_NAPI_SOURCES
  napi_init.cpp
)
if(CORE_ENABLE_GL)
  list(APPEND CORE_NAPI_SOURCES ohos_gl_xcomponent.cpp)
endif()

add_library(core_napi SHARED ${CORE_NAPI_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(core_napi PRIVATE "${CORE_INCLUDE}")
target_link_libraries(core_napi PUBLIC "${CORE_A_PATH}" libace_napi.z.so)

if(CORE_ENABLE_GL)
  if(NOT DEFINED ASSIMP_A_PATH OR NOT EXISTS "${ASSIMP_A_PATH}")
    message(FATAL_ERROR "CORE_ENABLE_GL=ON requires ASSIMP_A_PATH")
  endif()
  target_compile_definitions(core_napi PRIVATE CORE_ENABLE_GL=1)
  target_link_libraries(core_napi PUBLIC
    -Wl,--whole-archive "${ASSIMP_A_PATH}" -Wl,--no-whole-archive
    GLESv3
    EGL
    ace_ndk.z
    native_window
    hilog_ndk.z
    z
  )
endif()
